# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Neue Schnittstelle: dokumentierter STEP214-Import in frisches WorkPart.
Keine eigene NX-Laufzeit vorhanden. Importfunktionstest wird in NX vorgeschaltet.
Commit() darf hier None liefern; Erfolg wird an den wirklichen Part-Koerpern geprueft.
"""
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from haus2406_r03.haus_nx import NXAdapter
from haus2406_r03.haus_runtime import path_key
from .core import absolute, check_box, compare_boxes, sha256


class SceneAdapter(NXAdapter):
    def settings_file(self, base, configured):
        if configured.strip():
            p = Path(configured).expanduser()
            p = absolute(p if p.is_absolute() else base / p)
            if not p.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError('Angegebene STEP-Importkonfiguration fehlt: ' + str(p))
            return p
        candidates = []
        for variable in ('STEP214UG_DIR', 'UGII_BASE_DIR'):
            value = os.environ.get(variable, '')
            # Die NX-Sitzung kann mehr Umgebungsvariablen kennen als os.environ.
            try:
                value = self.session.GetEnvironmentVariableValue(variable) or value
            except Exception as ex:
                self.log('Hinweis: NX-Umgebungsvariable %s nicht gelesen: %s' % (variable, ex))
            if not value:
                continue
            if variable == 'STEP214UG_DIR':
                candidates.append(Path(value) / 'step214ug.def')
            else:
                candidates.extend(Path(value) / folder / 'step214ug.def' for folder in ('step214ug', 'STEP214UG'))
        for p in candidates:
            if p.is_file():
                return absolute(p)
        raise FileNotFoundError('STEP-Importdatei step214ug.def nicht gefunden. '
            'In data/EINSTELLUNGEN_R09.json step_settings_file auf die vorhandene NX-Import-DEF setzen. '
            'Keine Lizenzdatei oder exportseitige ugstep214.def verwenden. Geprueft: ' + '; '.join(map(str,candidates)))

    def preflight_importer(self):
        if not callable(getattr(self.session.DexManager, 'CreateStep214Importer', None)):
            raise RuntimeError('NX STEP214-Import-API fehlt.')
        if not hasattr(self.N.Step214Importer.ImportToOption, 'WorkPart'):
            raise RuntimeError('STEP214 ImportToOption.WorkPart fehlt.')

    def set_display(self, part):
        self.ensure_work(part)
        if self.session.Parts.Display is None or self.session.Parts.Display.Tag != part.Tag:
            status = self.session.Parts.SetDisplay(part, False, False)
            if not isinstance(status, tuple) or len(status) != 2:
                raise RuntimeError('SetDisplay-Rueckgabe unerwartet.')
            self.dispose(status[1])
        self.ensure_work(part)
        if self.session.Parts.Display.Tag != part.Tag:
            raise RuntimeError('Anzeigeteil konnte nicht umgeschaltet werden.')

    def prepare_view(self, part):
        self.set_display(part)
        try:
            view = part.ModelingViews.WorkView
            view.RenderingStyle = self.N.View.RenderingStyleType.ShadedWithEdges
            view.Orient(self.N.View.Canned.Isometric, self.N.View.ScaleAdjustment.Fit)
        except Exception as ex:
            self.warnings.append('Darstellungsstil manuell pruefen: ' + str(ex))
            self.log(self.warnings[-1])
        self.fit(part)

    def surface_box(self, body):
        return check_box(list(map(float, self.uf.ModlGeneral.AskBoundingBox(body.Tag))))

    def import_surface_part(self, out, source, spec, definition, name=None):
        name = name or spec['part_file']
        part = self.new_part(out / name, spec['id'])
        self.set_display(part)
        if len(list(part.Bodies)):
            raise RuntimeError('STEP-Zielteil ist nicht leer.')
        stage = out / '_step_quellen'
        stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        staged = stage / (Path(name).stem + '.step')
        if staged.exists():
            raise FileExistsError('Importquelle im Lauf existiert bereits: '+str(staged))
        shutil.copyfile(source, staged)
        if sha256(staged) != spec['sha256']:
            raise RuntimeError('Kopierte STEP-Datei stimmt nicht mit Quelle ueberein.')
        self.operation = 'STEP214-Import: ' + spec['id']
        builder = self.session.DexManager.CreateStep214Importer()
        if builder is None:
            raise RuntimeError('CreateStep214Importer lieferte keinen Builder.')
        failed = False
        try:
            builder.SettingsFile = str(definition)
            builder.InputFile = str(staged)
            builder.OutputFile = str(part.FullPath)
            builder.ImportTo = self.N.Step214Importer.ImportToOption.WorkPart
            builder.ImportToTeamcenter = False
            builder.FileOpenFlag = False
            builder.ProcessHoldFlag = True
            builder.FlattenAssembly = True
            builder.LayerDefault = 1
            builder.ObjectTypes.Curves = False
            builder.ObjectTypes.Surfaces = True
            builder.ObjectTypes.Solids = True
            builder.SewSurfaces = False
            builder.Optimize = False
            builder.SimplifyGeometry = False
            builder.SmoothBSurfaces = False
            # Die API dokumentiert NULL als Commit-Rueckgabe. Nicht als Fehler werten!
            builder.Commit()
        except Exception:
            failed = True
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                builder.Destroy()
            except Exception as ex:
                if not failed:
                    raise
                self.log('Zusaetzlicher Builder-Aufraeumfehler: ' + str(ex))
        self.ensure_work(part)
        self.update('STEP ' + spec['id'])
        bodies = list(part.Bodies)
        if any(b.OwningPart.Tag != part.Tag for b in bodies):
            raise RuntimeError('STEP-Koerper im falschen Part.')
        if any(b.IsSolidBody for b in bodies):
            raise RuntimeError('Volumenkoerper statt dokumentierter offener Oberflaechen importiert.')
        boxes = [self.surface_box(b) for b in bodies]
        check = compare_boxes(spec['face_bounding_boxes_mm'], boxes)
        face_count = sum(len(b.GetFaces()) for b in bodies)
        if face_count != spec['expected_faces']:
            raise RuntimeError('NX-Flaechenanzahl abweichend: %s Soll=%d Ist=%d. Importprotokoll pruefen.' %
                               (spec['id'], spec['expected_faces'], face_count))
        for source_index, body_index in check['mapping']:
            body = bodies[body_index]
            body.SetName(spec['id'] + '_QUELLFLAECHE_%04d' % (source_index+1))
            body.Layer = 1
            body.Unblank()
        for title, value in {
                'HAUS_REVISION': 'R09', 'HAUS_QUELLE': spec['source'],
                'HAUS_GEOMETRIEART': spec['kind'], 'HAUS_EINHEIT': 'mm',
                'HAUS_Z_BEZUG': 'QUELLHOEHE_MM_KEIN_EG_OFFSET',
                'HAUS_BESTAND_BESTAETIGT': 'NEIN',
                'HAUS_KONSTRUKTION': 'OFFENE_REFERENZFLAECHEN_KEIN_VOLUMEN',
                'HAUS_INPUT_SHA256': spec['sha256']}.items():
            self._set_user_attribute(part, title, value, spec['id'])
        self.prepare_view(part)
        saved = self.save(part)
        check.update({'id':spec['id'], 'sheets':len(bodies), 'faces':face_count,
                      'input_sha256':spec['sha256'], 'settings_file':str(definition)})
        return part, saved, check

    def add_at(self, master, path, name, translation=(0.0,0.0,0.0)):
        self.ensure_work(master)
        if not Path(path).is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError('Komponente fehlt: ' + str(path))
        mat = self.N.Matrix3x3()
        for k,v in zip(('Xx','Xy','Xz','Yx','Yy','Yz','Zx','Zy','Zz'),(1.,0.,0.,0.,1.,0.,0.,0.,1.)):
            setattr(mat,k,v)
        self.operation = 'AddComponent: ' + name
        comp, status = master.ComponentAssembly.AddComponent(str(path),'Entire Part',name,
            self.N.Point3d(*map(float,translation)),mat,-1)
        if status is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Komponenten-Ladestatus fehlt.')
        try:
            if comp is None or status.NumberUnloadedParts:
                raise RuntimeError('Komponente nicht vollstaendig geladen: '+name)
        finally:
            self.dispose(status)
        self.verify_component(comp,path,translation)
        return comp

    def verify_component(self, comp, path, translation):
        if comp.Prototype is None or path_key(comp.Prototype.FullPath) != path_key(path):
            raise RuntimeError('Komponenten-Prototyp falsch: '+str(path))
        self.check_millimeters(comp.Prototype, comp.Name)
        origin, rot = comp.GetPosition()
        values=[getattr(rot,k) for k in ('Xx','Xy','Xz','Yx','Yy','Yz','Zx','Zy','Zz')]
        if max(abs(float(a)-b) for a,b in zip(values,(1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1))) > 1e-8:
            raise RuntimeError('Unerwartete Komponentenrotation: '+comp.Name)
        if max(abs(float(a)-float(b)) for a,b in zip((origin.X,origin.Y,origin.Z),translation)) > 1e-5:
            raise RuntimeError('Unerwartete Komponentenverschiebung: '+comp.Name)
        return {'component':comp.Name,'file':str(path),'translation_mm':list(translation),'identity_rotation':True}
